name: Shadow Mapping
aliases: Shadow Mapping — Depth Pass FBO Setup, Shadow FBO Initialization, Shadow Map Setup
definition: A technique to efficiently render shadows by rendering the scene from the light's point of view to generate a depth map (shadow map). This determines if a point is occluded by another object from the light's perspective.
summary: Shadow Mapping detects cast shadows by comparing a pre-rendered light-space depth texture with camera depth, distinguishing itself through batched screen-space visibility tests.
